text: When a new neighbour arrives, a brief introduction plus one specific offer—such as collecting a parcel—makes it easier for them to accept help without guessing what’s available.
During the 1940s, Britain’s wartime allotments turned spare ground into food-growing plots; neighbours shared tools and know-how, showing how overlooked patches can become productive together.
At home, check one frequently used drawer for a small snag—such as a loose handle or tangled cables—and spend three minutes tightening or untangling what you can by hand.
